description: LUMO lattice-tower natural frequencies, healthy and damaged (DAM3/DAM4/DAM6): the paper's experimental Table 2 cross-referenced with the local SHM recordings.

paper.citation: N. Römgens, C. Hübler, R. Rolfes, Eng. Struct. 2024, DOI 10.1016/j.engstruct.2024.117570
paper.table: Table 2 — Modal parameters of the system identified from experimental data for healthy and damaged states
paper.method: covariance-driven stochastic subspace identification (SSI-COV), 10 min ambient-wind data sets, y-direction
paper.note: The paper reports frequencies only — no damping ratios for LUMO. The single 'damping rate of 0.01' refers to the simulated 3-DOF system (Section 3.1), not the tower.

mode_mapping.fundamental (~2.75 Hz): below Table 2's first row; consistent with the un-tabulated B1-y sway mode
mode_mapping.h1 (~13.5 Hz): NO Table 2 counterpart (-15 % from B2-y); likely torsional or x-direction (the paper notes torsional eigenmodes and that x-direction shifts are not identifiable)
mode_mapping.h2 (~16.0 Hz): paper B2-y (15.94 Hz healthy, +1.0 %) — the only clean one-to-one pair
mode_mapping.paper B3-y (40.76 / 34.88 Hz): the mode the paper used to dimension its autoencoder; NOT tracked by the local pipeline

sources.local_measured: lumo_damping_ratio.json (channel-mean Welch PSD, nperseg 32 s, parabolic peak interpolation)

caveats: DAM3/DAM4 B2-y rows shift by <1 % in the paper and <1.5 % locally — inside the 0.25 Hz bin quantisation documented in LUMO_DAM6_FREQUENCY_ANALYSIS.md (+-0.8 % at 16.1 Hz), so only DAM6 has a resolvable B2-y shift.
The paper notes the repair between damage instances 'led to a stiffening of the structure', so its per-case values are not referenced to one common healthy state.
Local medians use 5 recordings per state; the alternative 0.25 Hz-bin consensus in LUMO_DAM6_FREQUENCY_ANALYSIS.md (healthy 2.7502/13.5009/16.101, DAM6 2.7502/11.7508/14.551) differs by <= 0.15 Hz.

No damping ratios stored here: the paper reports none for LUMO, and zeta cannot be derived from frequencies (6e-5 Hz effect vs a 0.031 Hz bin). See lumo_damping_ratio.json for the measured half-power zeta.
